text:
alex: Quick heads up — after packaging the private installer for VPC customers (v1.4.3) we hit a manifest hash mismatch when validating signed-manifest.json. I paused final promotion.

deploy-bot: CI: release pipeline stopped: job #453 failed at manifest-hash-check. Artifact rejected.

maria: Ugh. Can we republish a corrected bundle or should we rollback the tag? What's the fastest path for customers?

dmitry: Most likely a packaging truncation on the gz step. Fastest: rebuild tar, update manifest, re-cosign, republish under the same semver but new artifact filename (republish1). Then run a small canary. Avoids DB/RT rollback.

jess: QA needs the new bundle to run the offline smoke tests. Can we do a 30m canary window to staging onprem first?

onprem-eng: +1 to canary. Acceptance criteria: manifests apply, images load, migrations dry-run. Keep rollout paused until canary green.

ci-cd-bot: repack-job/1863456789 triggered: building private-installer-v1.4.3+republish1.tar.gz

alex: Please paste sha256 and cosign key id here once ready. Also note the S3 key we replace vs new key.

dmitry: Local sha256 for repack: ```
$ sha256sum private-installer-v1.4.3+republish1.tar.gz
e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855  private-installer-v1.4.3+republish1.tar.gz
```
Updating signed-manifest.json -> new entry: {"name":"private-installer","version":"1.4.3","sha256":"e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855","signed_by":"cosign:keyid-abc123"}

maria: Scheduling canary to our staging onprem cluster at 2026-03-19T22:00Z. PM/ops will prepare customer comms after verification.

pm-ops: Drafted customer notification: "We republished the private installer due to a packaging integrity mismatch. No functional changes. Please re-download the artifact and verify sha256." We'll send to customers in Private-delivery and Support at release time.

qa-lead: Canary started at 2026-03-19T22:00Z. Running installer smoke: installer -> kube manifests -> image pulls -> readiness checks.

onprem-eng: Seeing one kube-probe timeout warning in smoke logs — unrelated to packaging. Proceed with canary. Set canary to 5% for 30m. @deploy-bot schedule.

deploy-bot: Scheduling rollout: release=private-installer v1.4.3+republish1, start=2026-03-19T22:00:00Z UTC, canary=5%, watch=30m, job=#457.

alex: After canary completes we'll update the release notes + docs with a short "republished" note and tag repo as republish1. Track cosign key id in the release artifact metadata.

dmitry: cosign sign complete. key id=cosign:keyid-abc123. Notarization logs uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/notarization/1863456789.log

ci-cd-bot: Job #457 canary passed -> promoting rollout to 100% over 15m.

maria: Copy for changelog: "- republish(v1.4.3): fixed packaging gz truncation causing manifest mismatch; no user-facing changes; artifact re-signed."

pm-ops: Sent customer notices; added support playbook: if customer pulled older bundle, instruct re-download + verify sha256 + re-run installer.

jess: QA smoke passed and closed. Marking canary accepted.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: private-installer v1.4.3+republish1 deployed to all private pools. All checks green. :tada:

alex: Thanks team. I'll follow-up with a short postmortem bullet list (packaging fix + CI check to fail earlier) and a ticket to add an automated post-packaging checksum assertion in pipeline.

jess: please also add a small note for onprem installers doc about verifying signed-manifest.json and sha256 before running installer.

maria: ticket created: INF-2891 "Add post-package sha256 assertion to repack job".

onprem-eng: resolved from infra side. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
